label: Mislabelled collections
rule: Check the title prefix against the assigned product family. Investigate; never auto-correct the source.

label: Edition aliases
rule: Second Edition and 2nd Edition are parallel labels; make reporting alias without overwriting input.

label: False digital-access match
rule: Gleebook is a print resource name containing the substring ebook. Token-agnostic matching is unsafe.

label: Inconsistent bundle wording
rule: Study Pack with Digital and Study Pack + Online Access may require business validation before merging.

label: Taxonomy drift
rule: A Primary product is mistakenly labelled Secondary in the subsegment field.

label: Premium TB outlier
rule: TB is an ambiguous abbreviation and carries a price outlier; investigate, do not automatically exclude.

label: Incomplete access duration
rule: Only some products explicitly say 18 months; blank is unspecified, not unlimited.

label: Part A + B premium
rule: Buying parts individually costs more than a single full volume; compare only matched product families and levels.

label: Level-specific starter prices
rule: Starter differs from upper levels for two selected product families; may reflect strategy rather than error.

label: Answer support parity
rule: The solution-key pairs are the same fictional list price; verify matching on edition and level.
